reviews.reason: Confirmed the explicit MNIST test accuracy for CNN/ensemble systems. Batch normalization and activation are not separately evaluated by assumption.
Confirmed only the complex GCN variant's two stated application tasks; generic GCN pairs retain uncertainty.
Confirmed our model resolves to GE-FSOD on both named datasets, not all individual components. Repeated aliases count as mentions, not distinct studies.
Role contrast is specific to LNSPL propagation versus EFGD placement-generation output. Keep all other anomaly/placement/transmission combinations unknown, not blanket negatives.

Confirmed HumanEval comparison plus repeated-sampling follow-up on the same problems. GPT-3 zero successes is still evaluated and used, not a negative. Do not evaluate the generic GPT family separately.
Confirmed dataset/full-name coreference and logistic regression answer-span evaluation. No named model is invented for the unspecified simple baseline.
Confirmed model/verifier/finetuning comparative benchmark context; do not equate the generative transformer with the verifier on all task pairs.
The spectral graph construction is explicitly the semi-supervised approach's method. Datasets are unnamed, so no fabricated citation-network names or evaluations.
Preserve LTSMs source spelling; SVM/CNN/LTSM/ResNet34 address the stated SER task. Augmentation and transfer-training role pairs remain deferred.
Confirmed DoubleWindowLSTM-CP prediction alias references. Correlation/dimensionality-reduction stages are not automatically declared prediction operators.
DNG named experiments are explicit; named base Stable Diffusion and limited NP performance do not establish absence or a separately attributed dataset evaluation.
CS-TDS resolves to our benchmark suite; query-method roles and multi-agent extraction are separately supported. No new dataset/entity normalization is applied.

The two negatives concern explicitly contrasted module outputs, not the whole DDCSR pipeline. Both modules contribute upstream/downstream but the source attributes each prediction operation to a different module.
Both the earlier and adapted fine-tuning approaches are used for beam prediction; inferior performance is not NO_RELATION. This is metadata annotation, not radio control implementation.

Confirmed UCF101 evaluation versus comparator ImageNet initialization roles in one explicit passage. These are document-supported negatives, not world-level claims that Skip-Clip was never tested elsewhere.
Keep CBFL disease-incidence/patient-response target unspecified; only opening general machine-learning task claims are resolved.

Confirmed pruning-input CNN/GoogleNet/ResNet/MobileNet versus RL-Pruner operator contrast. Do not invent negative relations for reinforcement-learning/pruning combinations merely because direct support is missing.
Detection study explicitly compares the listed families/architectures; poorer baselines remain used. This is defensive classification, not attack generation.
Confirmed only BigBiGAN gets the ImageNet evaluation. BigGAN extension and generic GAN background remain unresolved on dataset/unsupported representation pairs.
All comparison models explicitly serve the same defensive detection benchmark. Unnamed data cannot become DATASET entities or EVALUATED_ON labels.
Confirmed Penn Treebank perplexity and Wall Street Journal WER scopes; methods measured as a combined procedure are not isolated ablation claims. Original N-gram dataset pair remains unknown.
Confirmed system-level functions separately from LLM interpretation, GenAI creation and text-to-3D creation. No broad negative component-function filling.
ParkingSticker experiment explicit. PASCAL VOC remains only contextual and UNRESOLVED, preserving the prior conservative judgment instead of manufacturing a dataset negative.
The five method occurrences and two task wordings name the same civilian communication completion-time objective; only bibliographic labels, no UAV policy or hardware changes.
TaDaa assignment/recommendation outputs are explicit; hoped-for human issue resolution is left unknown rather than called performed or a forced negative.
Resolve compared concrete SDG/GPT-3.5 model mentions only; general LLM discussion remains unknown.
DAR and RNN synthesis roles are supported; prenet-to-task and postprocessor-to-spectral claims remain unknown. Unnamed Chinese corpus stays unnamed.
Confirmed framework operator versus assessed LLM object distinction. All negatives are scoped to the claimed assessment operator in this abstract; no universal denial of LLM capabilities.
